issues.quote: Because Agness infuriated Anna to no end.

Especially when Theodore's reports and elective evaluation sheets—assigned by Agness specifically to torment Theodore, much to Anna's dismay—were swept into the trash bin by the curatress with a single flick of her gold nails.
Because right now, in Agness's office, she and Theodore were discussing Anna's future.
He, Theodore, had no Plan. Nor any place in the Plans.
And propping up Seraph's economy even less so.
Don't tell me you actually considered doing something not for yourself," Agness smiled.
She held the cigarette with telekinesis
In truth, she was giving it her absolute all.
